raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
With `return_logprob` and no top-k or token-id logprob requests, the standard sampling path built `torch.log(probs)` over `[bs, vocab]` and clamped the whole tensor in place, only to gather one value per row. Gather the sampled entries first and apply the same log and clamp to them. Values are bitwise identical; other logprob requests keep the full-tensor path.

## Motivation

When only sampled-token logprobs are requested, the full `[bs, vocab]` log-probability tensor is unnecessary. We only need one probability per sampled token.

The existing path performs a full-tensor `torch.log(probs)` followed by an in-place clamp, then gathers the sampled entries. This introduces several `[bs, vocab]` memory passes and a full-tensor allocation.

This change gathers the sampled probabilities first, then applies `log` and `clamp` only to the resulting `[bs]` tensor.

## Modifications

- In the standard sampling path, keep a reference to `probs` instead of computing `torch.log(probs)` when:
  - `return_logprob` is enabled.
  - `SGLANG_RETURN_ORIGINAL_LOGPROB` is not enabled.
  - `logprobs_via_logsoftmax_kernel` is `None`.
  - No request in the batch requires top logprobs or token-id logprobs.
- In the `return_logprob` path, compute:
  `torch.log(probs.gather(1, ids)).view(-1).clamp_(min=finfo.min)`
- Keep `compute_logprobs` and the existing full-tensor path unchanged for all other cases.

## Accuracy Tests

Compared baseline and candidate using identical logits and PyTorch seeds across:

- Batch sizes: 1, 8, 64, 256
- Sampling modes: top-p/top-k filtered, simple, min-p
- Sampled-token logprobs with `top_logprobs=0`
- Top logprobs and token-id logprobs, which use the unchanged path

Sampled token IDs and `next_token_logprobs` are `torch.equal()` across both arms. Top-logprob and token-id outputs are also equal.

`test_sampling_mask.py::TestSamplingMaskCapture` parity was verified, along with the CPU sampling test suite.

The log and clamp operations are applied to the same sampled probability values in the same order, so the resulting token logprobs are bitwise identical.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Measured `sampler_logprob_forward_us` using CUDA events on NVIDIA B300 SXM6 PC x1.

8 trials per arm after 2 warmup trials, interleaved ABBA. Lower is better.

| Arm | n | Median |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Baseline | 8 | 865.28 us |
| Candidate | 8 | 715.74 us |

This is a **17.28% reduction** in `Sampler.forward` time for the measured workload (`0.8272x` baseline).

The benchmark targets `bs=256` with sampled-token logprobs and no top-k/token-id logprob requests.

The optimization removes the full `[bs, vocab]` `log` and clamp work and avoids the corresponding full-tensor intermediate for this case.

The gain does not apply to greedy batches, deterministic mode, `SGLANG_RETURN_ORIGINAL_LOGPROB`, or batches containing requests that require top or token-id logprobs.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to the [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to the [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process.
2. Get approvals from CODEOWNERS and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests as required.
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -17,6 +17,7 @@
     SamplingMaskStatus,
 )
 from sglang.srt.layers.logprob_processor import (
+    LogprobResult,
     OutputLogprobProcessor,
 )
 from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_exec, get_parallel, get_server_args
@@ -177,6 +178,8 @@ def forward(
         sampling_mask_batch_indices = sampling_info.sampling_mask_batch_indices
         return_sampling_mask = sampling_mask_batch_indices is not None
         sampling_mask_capture = None
+        # Probs kept for a gather-first token logprob when nothing else is requested.
+        token_logprob_probs = None
 
         if sampling_info.is_all_greedy:
             _trace_e2e_sampler("greedy_enter")
@@ -269,22 +272,35 @@ def forward(
                     simple_sampling_case,
                 )
                 if return_logprob and not SGLANG_RETURN_ORIGINAL_LOGPROB:
-                    logprobs = (
-                        logprobs_via_logsoftmax_kernel
-                        if logprobs_via_logsoftmax_kernel is not None
-                        else torch.log(probs)
-                    )
+                    if logprobs_via_logsoftmax_kernel is not None:
+                        logprobs = logprobs_via_logsoftmax_kernel
+                    elif not any(top_logprobs_nums) and not any(
+                        x is not None for x in token_ids_logprobs
+                    ):
+                        token_logprob_probs = probs
+                    else:
+                        logprobs = torch.log(probs)
                 del probs
 
         if return_logprob:
             if SGLANG_RETURN_ORIGINAL_LOGPROB:
                 logprobs = original_logprobs
-            logprob_result = self.output_logprob_processor.compute_logprobs(
-                logprobs,
-                top_logprobs_nums,
-                token_ids_logprobs,
-                batch_next_token_ids,
-            )
+            if token_logprob_probs is not None:
+                # Same log + clamp as compute_logprobs, on the sampled entries only.
+                token_logprobs = torch.log(
+                    token_logprob_probs.gather(
+                        1, batch_next_token_ids.long().view(-1, 1)
+                    ).view(-1)
+                ).clamp_(min=torch.finfo(token_logprob_probs.dtype).min)
+                del token_logprob_probs
+                logprob_result = LogprobResult(token_logprobs=token_logprobs)
+            else:
+                logprob_result = self.output_logprob_processor.compute_logprobs(
+                    logprobs,
+                    top_logprobs_nums,
+                    token_ids_logprobs,
+                    batch_next_token_ids,
+                )
             logprob_result.write_output_to(logits_output)
 
         _trace_e2e_sampler("token_sync_enter")
